title: C24/18/2021 of BHUMI ADHIKARI Vs SURAJ SINGH ADHIKARI

with Signatures
COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C24 No. 18 of 2021
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, A.C.J.
Mr. Devesh Upreti, Advocate for the
petitioner.
2. There is no representation for the
respondent.
3. Respondent has filed a petition for
dissolution of marriage before Judge, Fam ily
Court, Haldwani, District Nainital, which is
num bered as Dissolution of Marriage Petition
No. 44 of 2021. Applicant has sought transfer
of the said petition to a court of com petent
jurisdiction, in District Cham pawat.
4. In para no. 12 of the Transfer
Application, it is stated that although, none of
the parties nor their in-laws ever lived at
Haldwani, yet the petition has been filed at
Haldwani, by giving wrong address to show
that respondent is residing at Haldwani. It is
further stated that applicant is residing with
her parents at Cham pawat with her three
years old daughter, and it is not possible for
her to attend the court proceedings at
Haldwani on each and every date. It is further
stated that applicant does not have any source
of incom e, and being a lady, it is not safe for
her to travel from Cham pawat to Haldwani
with her three years old child.
5. The office report dated 27.04.2022
regarding service upon respondent is
extracted below: -
"Undelivered envelope received back with
remark "refused to receive".
6. A letter issued by Major Adjutant for
Com manding Officer addressed to MH
Ranikhet, c/ o 56 APO is placed on record,
which indicates that the court docum ents

received from Deputy Registrar, High Court
were re-directed for service upon the
respondent. Thus, service is sufficient upon
the respondent, but, he has chosen not to put
in appearance.
7. Having regard to the fact that applicant
is a lady, who has to look after her daughter,
aged about three years, the proceedings of
Dissolution of Marriage Petition No. 44 of 2021
are transferred from the Fam ily Court,
Haldwani to a Court of com petent jurisdiction
in District Cham pawat. The record of the case
shall be transferred to the transferee Court,
within three weeks. The transferee court is
requested to m ake endeavour to decide the
aforesaid petition for dissolution of m arriage
filed by respondent as early as possible.
8. Registry shall com municate this order to
both the Courts, within a week.
( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, A.C.J.)
 06.01.2024
Navin
